_how_to_use: One block per week. A link set to null shows the step as Not posted yet. extras are the second links listed under a step in the step list. A week whose steps all have pages is drawn as the straight line: each step shows what (one line) and its pages [{label, href or null, desc, optional}]; empty is the text for a step with no pages; loop draws the way back after that step; title, sub, time and badges override the defaults. Run: python3 tools/build_week_entry.py 4

4.title: Membrane potential, neurons and synapses

preread.what: Look over the chapter before you learn it: the figures and the bold terms. Then fill in the pre-read worksheet. Stop at 30 minutes.

pages.label: Pre-read and worksheet
pages.desc: The figures, the bold terms, and the pre-read worksheet you turn in. Already printed it? You do not need to print it again.

first.sub: Lessons, then your Competency Study Guide
first.what: Work through the walkthroughs in order, typing each prediction into the worksheet on the right before you press Show me. Then use the written notes to fill in your Competency Study Guide in your first color.

pages.label: Competency Study Guide
pages.desc: Your worksheet for the week. Print it, or work the same prompts on your own paper. Already printed it from the Start here page? You do not need to print it again.

pages.label: Walkthroughs and slides
pages.desc: The Week 4 lessons in order, starting with the walkthroughs. Short Khan Academy videos sit inside each walkthrough, on the steps they match: press Stuck? Watch a short explanation. Opens Monday, September 28 at 8:00 am.

pages.label: Written notes
pages.desc: Notes for each walkthrough in bullets, definitions and sequences, to study from after the walkthrough. Read them on screen, or print them: the PDF link is at the top of the notes page. If you already printed the notes, you do not need to print them again.

second.sub: The same lessons, in a second color
second.what: Go back through the same walkthroughs, slides and notes from First pass. Add to your Competency Study Guide in a second color.
second.empty: No new pages. Use the ones from First pass.

upload.what: Upload the Competency Study Guide you printed at the start of the week, or your own labeled pages, now filled in with both colors from Steps 2 and 3. Scan or photograph every page, combine them into one PDF, and upload it to the Step 4 assignment in Canvas.

pages.label: Upload your guide in Canvas
pages.desc: The Week 4, Step 4 assignment. Upload one PDF with every page, competency 1 first.

pages.label: How the Competency Study Guide works
pages.desc: What to scan and how to make one PDF

study.what: Pull the week back out of memory. Spread it over at least four days instead of one sitting.

pages.label: Rx Cards
pages.desc: At least 20 cards a session and 60 cards a week

pages.label: Brain Dump
pages.desc: Pick a competency, close everything, write or draw all you can, then check it

check.what: Take the Mastery Check, about 30 questions a try. Do at least 3 tries with Study it in between, and aim for 80 percent before you stop. You can always do more. Turn in the report from every try.

pages.label: Mastery Check
pages.desc: Set to Week 4 and 30 questions. Each try is a fresh set.

pages.label: How to submit your reports
pages.desc: Save each report as a PDF, or print your weekly practice log, which has every try in one PDF

check.time: 30 to 50 min per try, at least 3 tries

lab.what: Run PhysioEx, then fill in the lab worksheet and turn it in.

pages.label: PhysioEx lab
pages.desc: The simulation and what to record

pages.label: Lab worksheet
pages.desc: Where your results and answers go. Already printed it? You do not need to print it again.

case.title: Your patient, in Rounds
case.sub: Work the case in Camila's online chart
case.what: Rounds is Camila's online chart, laid out like a hospital record. Follow the steps down the left side: predict first, file the numbers, answer the five questions and your entry point's question, and write your note. You type everything, so nothing is printed.

pages.label: Rounds: Week 4
pages.desc: Everything for the case is here. Weeks 1 to 3 are already filed from your paper chart.

patient.title: Check your chart
patient.what: A quick check. In Rounds, click My entries and finish anything that says Not written yet. Then sign and click Export this week to PDF, and save it. You upload the whole chart once, in the week of Midterm 1.

pages.label: Rounds: Week 4
pages.desc: Click My entries on the right to see anything still empty.

discussion.title: Exam practice and Discussion 4
discussion.sub: Two questions on video, then your meta-analysis
discussion.what: Two timed quizzes, one question each. In each, you record on Studio inside the quiz: 15 minutes building your model from memory on a whiteboard, then 5 to 7 minutes teaching it. Your videos go to me only, graded complete or incomplete. Then post your meta-analysis in Discussion 4 and reply to two classmates.

pages.label: Directions for the exam practice
pages.desc: Read these first: what you need, the timing, the steps and how it is graded. Your Discussion 4 prompt is here too.
